annotations.title: Check links for phishing and malware

description: Checks one URL, or up to 25 URLs in a single call, against RelayShield's threat-intelligence corpus for known phishing, malware, and scam abuse. Provide either `url` (a single http:// or https:// link) or `urls` (an array of up to 25 links). Returns a per-link verdict of FLAGGED or unknown with the reasons behind each verdict, plus counts of checked, flagged, and incomplete links. A verdict of unknown means nothing is known against the link; this tool never reports a link as safe.

url.description: A single link starting with http:// or https://. Omit when sending urls.

urls.description: Up to 25 links to check in one call. Omit when sending url.

name: check_link
